description: Same legal Lv50 builds, ranks and six-round script before/after. Three core new units R5; Lisbeth R5M3 + MAG10 signature + Harvest revelation. Six legal T4 slots. Optimize source MAG among registered MAG-effect subsets, hold winners fixed across versions. Controlled targets with actual Miraebolis Lv90 RES, not boss clear or win-rate test. Also RES0 and low-HP peak controls.
